items.title: Pick-up
items.text: Only you or an adult you name. Tell us before someone new comes

items.title: School bus
items.text: A proper preschool bus, a minder on board until every child is off

items.title: Meals
items.text: A leader eats every meal with the children, 125 g of each dish kept 48 hours

items.title: Water
items.text: Drowning is the top injury death for ages 1 to 14. Nothing replaces watching

items.title: Getting lost
items.text: Teach your address, phone and your names, and to ask the police

footnote: Source: Kindergarten Work Regulations, School Bus Safety Regulations (Order No. 617), school food safety rules, China CDC, Guidelines for Ages 3 to 6
notes: Five safety tips. Pick-up: under the Kindergarten Work Regulations, children are collected by a guardian or an adult the guardian names. Please tell the teacher before someone new comes, because we will not hand your child to anyone we don't know. School bus: under the School Bus Safety Regulations, children ride a dedicated school bus with a minder on board the whole way, who leaves the bus only after making sure every child is off. Meals: under the 2019 rules on school food safety and nutrition, a kindergarten leader eats with the children at every meal, and at least 125 grams of each dish is kept chilled for 48 hours or more. Water: China CDC says drowning is the leading cause of injury death for children and teenagers aged 1 to 14 in China. Drowning is often fast and silent, a swim ring is not a proper flotation aid, and nothing replaces an adult actually watching. Getting lost: the guidelines suggest teaching children their home address, phone number and parents' names, and to ask the police for help. Never leave a child alone at home or in a car.
